sources.snippet: Introduction Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct is a high-efficiency large language model developed by MoonshotAI. Built with an innovative hybrid linear attention architecture and equipped with 48B total parameters, it is specially optimized for long-context comprehension, multi-turn dialogue and complex reasoning scenarios, supporting an ultra-long context window up to 1 million tokens.
